mimic_iv_ecg.caution: ECG device timestamps may be out of sync with clinical timestamps.

mimic_iv.access: credentialed; no access controls may be bypassed
join_keys: hadm_id when a defensible encounter link exists

scientific_requirements: index ECG confirmed sinus using information available at ECG time
exclude or mark indeterminate any prior AF
positive requires a timestamped post-index AF event within 365 days
negative requires verifiable complete follow-up for 365 days
a later billing diagnosis alone does not establish disease onset
PTB-XL and MIMIC patients must never be joined
reason: Authorized longitudinal ECG and clinical files are not both present.
